why.en: This is the same plain HTTP request your phone sends after joining Wi-Fi. On open internet it returns 204.
why.hinglish: Ye wahi plain HTTP request hai jo aapka phone Wi-Fi join karne ke baad bhejta hai. Khule internet pe ye 204 deta hai.

expect.en: 'HTTP/1.1 204 No Content' with an empty body. Behind a captive portal you would see 302 and a Location header pointing at the login page instead. Headers vary.
expect.hinglish: 'HTTP/1.1 204 No Content' khali body ke saath. Captive portal ke peeche aap 302 aur login page ki taraf point karta Location header dekhoge. Headers alag ho sakte hain.

title.en: Show the redirect on a plain HTTP page
title.hinglish: Plain HTTP page pe redirect dekho

why.en: A 302 with a Location header is what the gateway sends to trap you. Any plain HTTP redirect looks like it.
why.hinglish: Location header ke saath 302 wahi hai jo gateway aapko trap karne ke liye bhejta hai. Koi bhi plain HTTP redirect aisa hi dikhta hai.

expect.en: Usually '301 Moved Permanently' with a Location header. A captive portal sends a 302 with its own login URL. Output varies.
expect.hinglish: Aam taur pe Location header ke saath '301 Moved Permanently'. Captive portal apne login URL ke saath 302 bhejta hai. Output alag ho sakta hai.

title.en: Find the probe, 302 and POST in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein probe, 302 aur POST dhoondo

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark and filter for the portal conversation.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur portal ki baat-cheet filter karo.

expect.en: The 302 from the gateway, the POST /accept, the final 204, and the DHCP option 114 (may show as unknown option 114).
expect.hinglish: Gateway ka 302, POST /accept, aakhri 204, aur DHCP option 114 (unknown option 114 ki tarah dikh sakta hai).
